changelog:
Initial release – streamlined, explicit email management via user-authorized IMAP/SMTP accounts.

- Supports rapid search, retrieval, summarization, prioritization, drafting, and explicit sending for supported email providers.
- Enforces strict safety contracts: all outbound email requires explicit user confirmation; never collects or displays credentials in chat.
- Uses only safe, read-only IMAP operations for mailbox access; all write actions are refused or redirected to supported drafting/sending workflows.
- Provides clear error-handling and user guidance for configuration or provider selection steps.
- Designed for concise fact-based digests and action lists, always citing factual sources in results.
summary: Quickly search, retrieve, summarize, prioritize, draft, and explicitly send email for user-authorized IMAP/SMTP accounts.
